rule: Virtualize lists with more than 50 items
implementation: Use FlashList (Shopify) or FlatList with getItemLayout and keyExtractor
avoid: ScrollView with .map() for large datasets — causes jank and memory issues

rule: Always provide stable keyExtractor returning unique string IDs
implementation: keyExtractor={(item) => item.id.toString()}
avoid: Using index as key for mutable lists — causes incorrect re-renders

rule: Use ItemSeparatorComponent instead of margin on list items
implementation: ItemSeparatorComponent={() => <View style={styles.separator} />}
avoid: Adding marginBottom to list items — double spacing at list end

rule: Use React Navigation Bottom Tab for top-level screens
implementation: @react-navigation/bottom-tabs with 3-5 items including icon + label
avoid: Nesting tab bars within tabs — breaks back stack and user mental model

rule: Use Stack.Navigator for detail/drill-down screens
implementation: @react-navigation/native-stack (native performance) over JS stack
avoid: Manually managing screen visibility with state — breaks back gesture

rule: Always respect safe area insets on every screen
implementation: Use SafeAreaProvider + useSafeAreaInsets or SafeAreaView
avoid: Hardcoding padding for notch — breaks on different device models

rule: Configure deep linking for all key screens
implementation: expo-linking or React Navigation linking config in app entry
avoid: No deep link config — push notifications with no screen target

rule: All interactive elements must be at least 44x44pt
implementation: Use minWidth: 44 minHeight: 44 or hitSlop on smaller elements
avoid: Icon buttons < 44pt without hitSlop — causes misses on mobile

rule: Extend tap area without changing visual size
implementation: hitSlop={{ top: 8 bottom: 8 left: 8 right: 8 }}
avoid: Relying only on visual bounds for small interactive elements

rule: All pressable elements must show pressed state immediately
implementation: Use Pressable with style={({pressed}) => pressed && styles.pressed}
avoid: TouchableOpacity alone with no visual change — user doubts tap registered

rule: Keep one gesture type per interaction region
implementation: Use ScrollView horizontal={false} for vertical lists; horizontal swipe in separate container
avoid: Horizontal swipe lists inside vertical ScrollViews — gesture conflicts

rule: Swipe-to-delete or swipe actions need clear affordance
implementation: Use react-native-gesture-handler Swipeable with action labels visible
avoid: Hidden swipe actions with no visual hint — users never discover them

rule: Use expo-image or FastImage for optimized image loading
implementation: expo-image with contentFit="cover" and placeholder shimmer
avoid: Plain <Image> from React Native — no caching or optimization

rule: Never create objects in render — causes reconciliation on every frame
implementation: Extract styles to StyleSheet.create outside component
avoid: style={{ marginTop: 8 }} inline in JSX — new object every render

rule: Wrap pure list item components in React.memo
implementation: export default React.memo(ListItem)
avoid: Wrapping every component in memo — overhead without benefit; profile first

rule: Extract callbacks to useCallback or top-level functions
implementation: const handlePress = useCallback(() => { ... } [dep]) passed as prop
avoid: onPress={() => doSomething()} inline in FlashList renderItem — new ref every render

rule: All interactive elements need accessibilityLabel
implementation: accessibilityLabel="Close dialog" on icon-only Pressable
avoid: Icon-only buttons without accessibilityLabel — screen reader says "button" only

rule: Set accessibilityRole matching the element's function
implementation: accessibilityRole="button" "link" "checkbox" "header" as appropriate
avoid: No accessibilityRole on custom interactive components

rule: Respect system reduceMotion preference
implementation: Use useReduceMotion() from react-native-reanimated; provide no-motion fallback
avoid: Skipping animation preference check — forces animation on users who need reduced motion

rule: Support system text scale changes
implementation: Use scaledFontSize or avoid maxFontSizeMultiplier={1} unless layout-critical
avoid: Hardcoding pixel font sizes and capping scaling — fails accessibility audit

rule: Floating CTAs and tab bars need bottom safe area
implementation: Add paddingBottom: insets.bottom to fixed bottom elements
avoid: Fixed bottom buttons overlapping the home indicator on iPhone

rule: Form screens must handle software keyboard
implementation: KeyboardAvoidingView with behavior="padding" (iOS) or "height" (Android)
avoid: Content hidden behind keyboard with no scrolling adjustment

rule: Use flexbox for layout instead of absolute positioning
implementation: Flex-based layouts with proper gap and padding
avoid: Absolute positioning for multiple layout elements — breaks on different screen sizes

rule: Use correct keyboard type for each field
implementation: keyboardType="email-address" "numeric" "phone-pad" "url" as appropriate
avoid: keyboardType="default" for email/phone — shows wrong keyboard on mobile

rule: Only autoFocus the first field in a single-input screen or primary search
implementation: autoFocus={true} only on login email or search bar; never inside lists
avoid: autoFocus on multiple fields or inside modal lists — keyboard fights focus

rule: Set returnKeyType to guide form submission
implementation: returnKeyType="next" between fields "done" or "send" on last field
avoid: Default return key type — users unsure when to submit
